page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a running head at the top and a page number at the top right. Catchword at the lower right and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: filiosq; ejus autoritatis suæ præsidio con-folatus sit : notum qvippe est omnibus, Berullū à Richelio & ab ætatis illius scri-ptoribꝰ diffamatū, jubente Richelio, qva-si ille sub specie pietatis non parvū rebus Franciæ detrimentum attulisset. Novis-sime qvcqve Richelius Claudium Segve-notum, Congregationis Oratorii Pres-byterum, in custodia acris, vulgo dictæ la Bastille Poni Jusserat; & ob hanc po-tissimuū causam Morinus Celloto & Ra-bardeo Jesuitis infensissimum se præbuit, qvi in suis operibus Segvenotum miris modis traduxerant : Hic opusculum Bea-ti Augustini de Virginitate èLatino Gal-licum fecerat auxeratqve notis, qvas ut scandalosas & communi Ecclesiæ praxi contrarias damnârunt Theologi Parisien-ses, ad id eos impellente Richelio, qvi Se-gvenoti ad sobrietatem non sapientis in, genium reformidabat.
Segvenotus vir erat magna de se sentiens, judicii non contemnendi, & cum Abbate Sancyra-no, cujus doctrinam & mores plurimi fa-cibat, amicitia conjunctus severioris di-sci-

page.notes: The bottom line "D 4" is the signature and "sci-" the catchword. Small stray marks (asterisk-like specks beside "miris" and "Bea-") are printer's marks or specks, not text. Possible misreading: "Bcrullū" may be "Berullū" (the name Bérulle); copied as it appears on the scan. The second paragraph begins mid-line at "Segvenotus vir", after a clear gap.
